description: The chart illustrates CoLeG-R performance (in percent) for three LLaMA-2 model sizes under different fine-tuning settings. The horizontal axis contains the categorical model labels “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “CoLeG-R (%)” on a linear scale from 0 to 90 with tick marks at regular 10-point intervals. For each model category, four adjacent bars are shown as a grouped set: a light blue bar with diagonal hatch (baseline, label not fully visible in the legend) at approximately 66–67% for 7B, about 70% for 13B, and about 81% for 70B; a light orange bar with horizontal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀” at about 66–67% (7B), about 74% (13B), and about 82% (70B); a light purple bar with diagonal hatch labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” at about 81% (7B), about 85% (13B), and about 85% (70B); and a solid light pink bar labeled “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” at about 84% (7B), about 80% (13B), and about 84% (70B). The bars are not presented as stacked, and within each model group they appear in a consistent left-to-right order matching the legend; no individual bars are specially outlined or annotated beyond the legend and hatch/color styling.
